name: HC17: No. active on ART who received CPT/Dapsone at the last visit during the reporting quarter
description: Counts unique HIV patients who had started ART and whose last ART visit during the reporting quarter included a medication order for Cotrimoxazole, Septrin, or Dapsone.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id

  AND EXISTS (

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
        AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_medication_orders o
      WHERE o.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND o.encounter_id = a.encounter_id
        AND UPPER(o.drug) IN (
            'COTRIMOXAZOLE',
            'SEPTRIN',
            'DAPSONE'
        )
  );
